summary: Separate browsing, playback authorization and video delivery, then examine graceful degradation.
scope: A simplified streaming journey based on public resilience and delivery material. Service names and dependencies illustrate the pattern, not Netflix’s complete internal topology.
author: Thoth

sources.title: Making the Netflix API more resilient

componentNotes.client: Requests browse results and playback, then downloads video segments separately.
componentNotes.gateway: Routes browse and playback calls to independent services.
componentNotes.catalog: Returns title metadata without depending on playback authorization.
componentNotes.recommend: Personalizes the browse experience and can fail independently of playback.
componentNotes.play: Creates a playback session and checks playback entitlement.
componentNotes.account: Decides whether the current viewer can play the title.
componentNotes.cdn: Delivers encoded video segments outside the application request path.
componentNotes.cache: Supplies a browse fallback when personalization responds slowly.
componentNotes.events: Buffers viewing events separately from the playback path.
componentNotes.analytics: Consumes viewing events without blocking the player.
